versions.changelog:
Initial release of the World Cup 2026 Content Factory skill:

- Instantly generates complete content packs for a single 2026 World Cup match: article, video script, social post, and headline ideas.
- Automatically detects PRE-MATCH (if no score) vs POST-MATCH (if a real score is given) and produces context-appropriate content.
- Customizes tone, byline, and football/soccer wording based on creator's handle and audience.
- Includes ad slots, engagement prompts, and flexible headline/thumbnail hooks.
- Strictly uses only real and verifiable match information; never fabricates scores, lineups, or event details.
- No betting or odds; social games and polls are always free and for fun.
